matchTalkingPoints: Following a well-received Dynasty show, there were plenty of changes in the rankings this week! The highest rated one-on-one match was Moxley vs Ospreay (8.55), which led to big gains for both of them. The Bucks vs Okada & Takeshita was the highest rated match of all (8.96) consolidated Matt and Nick's place at number 1 in the Men's Tag rankings, extending their advantage over FTR, who gained slightly from their decent but less spectacular (7.56) title match against Cage & Copeland.
othersToNote:
Along with Ospreay, MJF gained plenty of places (5) this week. Also, we saw good gains in the Men's rankings from Omega, Allin and Andrade.

Okada & Takeshita have re-entered the Men's Tag rankings at number 3, though based on the post-match aftermath, it is highly unlikely we will see these two team again anytime soon!

No major changes in the Women's Division other than the re-entry of Queen Aminata. Welcome back! The Women's Tag title match was on the pre-show, so did not count. The Dogs have entered the Trios down at number 6 - their entry rating brought down by a below-average title match at Dynasty. The Conglomeration (Cassidy, O'Reilly & Strong) is the new Trio on the block. As they have only had one match, they do not make the rankings list, yet!
